description: Search that only considers documents the asking user may read, enforced inside the retriever before ranking.
The authenticated identity a request runs as (user, tenant, groups), taken from a verified token, never from the prompt or the model.
Documents of one customer organization are never visible to another, whatever the groups or query. Enforced by filter, namespace or a separate index.
Access control list: the users and groups allowed to read a document, synced from the source system and stored with each chunk.
A document with no matching grant is invisible. Missing or empty ACLs never mean public.
A deleted or outdated document whose chunks remain in the index and keep answering questions.
Reconstructing text from its embedding vector. Why vector stores need the same protection as the documents.
